audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3 and 4-5 were scored Singed while whys[2] and whys[3] call them your chip window and 'your cleanest lane window'; Level 6 and first item were scored Lillia/Singed while both whys say even.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror (singed__lillia) both read Lillia / Skill / Lillia / Lillia / Skill / Skill / Singed. The two directions must not contradict, and the prose already agreed with the mirror.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 4 and 5 proposed as matched full+content pairs onto the mirror's chart, with ratings set inverse to the opponent's page.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why promised guaranteed ganks at 6 and phases[5].why promised melting juggernauts at first item — both rows are even stages.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s and only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust, and the drowsy delay lets a Singed simply keep running. His first-item spike is proxy tempo, not a fight he loses.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to match their stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Fling his W in eleven places. Fling is E — 125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. His W is Mega Adhesive, a 1000-range vial that slows and grounds. And the interaction that decides the matchup was never stated: a target flung into Mega Adhesive is rooted.
audit.why: Reading 'stay outside his W fling range' sends you dodging a 1000-range vial when the flip itself is a 125-range melee button. The real tell is the vial hitting the ground first — dodge that and Fling is just a reposition.
audit.corrected: Every mislabel fixed, Fling's 125 range and 10s cooldown given, and the goo-then-Fling root order stated in early, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in the first person ('if he flings me', 'my best window').
audit.why: The site speaks to the reader in second person everywhere else.
audit.corrected: All three converted inside the length band.

edits.before: Track Singed’s Fling: The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Fling (E): 125 range, 10s cooldown, and it roots only if he laid Mega Adhesive (W) where you land — dodge the vial, not the flip.

edits.before: Singed only has poison trail and his W fling early, and both of you are weak at level 1 — farm with Q from the edge and never stand in fling range.

edits.after: He can Fling (E) you onto his poison and draft away on his passive speed, but your Q stacks keep you outside its 125 range — a wash.

edits.after: Full-rank Blooming Blows sweetspots plus the Dream Dust DoT let you chip a Singed who has to walk straight at you, and your Q move speed keeps you outside Fling's 125-unit range the whole time.

edits.before: Singed at levels 1-3 has only his poison trail and the W fling, and the fling is the entire matchup — if he flings me I get dragged onto his poison and he kites away on his own move speed. So I never hop in with Blooming Blows where he can flip me; I farm with Q from the edge and start the Dream Dust burn from range. The good news is he has to walk straight at me to do anything, and my passive plus Q move speed mean I'm never standing in fling range when he commits. Don't chase his run-it-down bait into his trail.
edits.after: Singed at levels 1-3 has Poison Trail and then Fling (E), and Fling is the entire matchup — flipped, you land on his poison and he drafts away on his passive speed. Never hop in with Blooming Blows inside its 125 range; farm with Q from the edge and start the Dream Dust burn from distance. Watch the order: Mega Adhesive (W) hits the ground first, then Fling, because a target flung into the goo is rooted outright. The good news is he must walk straight at you, and your Q move speed means you are never standing still when he commits.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are my best window: full-rank Blooming Blows sweetspots and the compounding Dream Dust DoT chip him down while I stay outside his W fling, and a Singed who has to keep walking into the burn just feeds it. I refuse to step onto his poison trail and I keep my Swirlseed slow held to punish a fling whiff or peel his step-up. At 6 my Lilting Lullaby is real but situational — the sleep is delayed and he'll just W-fling or run through it solo, so I cash it with my jungler or to interrupt his all-in, not to burst a drain-tank by myself.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your best window: full-rank Blooming Blows sweetspots and the compounding Dream Dust DoT chip him down while you stay outside Fling's 125 range, and a Singed who has to keep walking into the burn only feeds it. Refuse to stand on his poison trail, and hold the Swirlseed slow for a Fling whiff or his step-up. At 6 Lilting Lullaby is real but situational — the sleep is delayed and he will simply keep running through it, so cash it with your jungler or to interrupt his all-in, not to burst a drain-tank alone.

edits.before: This is where Singed takes it back. Once he buys Rylai's his poison trail permaslows me, and a slowed Lillia loses the one thing that keeps her safe — the kite. His W fling plus that slow catches me mid-hop, and his proxy farming and run-it-down sustain out-tempo my DoT in any extended chase. My first-item Liandry's/Riftmaker spike does bite his HP pool, so I want to convert my 4-to-first-item lead into roams and tower pressure before his slow comes online. Late, I don't try to solo a Singed who can flip and chase me — I R to peel his fling in fights and let my team handle the run-down.
edits.after: This is where Singed takes it back. Once he buys Rylai's his poison trail permaslows you, and a slowed Lillia loses the one thing keeping her safe — the kite. Mega Adhesive lands from 1000 range to pin the ground under you, Fling follows, and his proxy farming and run-it-down sustain out-tempo your DoT in any long chase. Your Liandry's/Riftmaker spike does bite his HP pool, so convert the levels 4-to-first-item lead into roams and tower pressure before that slow comes online. Late, don't solo a Singed who can flip you — hold R to peel the Fling in fights and let your team handle the run-down.

edits.before: Stack Blooming Blows sweetspots and the Dream Dust burn while your Q move speed keeps you just outside his W fling range
edits.after: Stack Blooming Blows sweetspots and the Dream Dust burn while your Q move speed keeps you outside Fling's 125-unit range

edits.before: Land his W fling to flip your kite, drag you into his poison trail, and proc his Rylai's slow on you
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive (W) first, then Fling (E) you into it — landing in the goo roots you outright

notes: Mega Adhesive's grounding is dead weight in this matchup — Lillia has no dash — so per the relevance rule I wrote nothing about it and kept the vial's value as the slow plus the Fling-landing root. This matches the mirror's note. Insanity Potion (100s flat) applying Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail is genuine but Lillia has no meaningful self-healing, so it also stayed off the page.
